title: Copilot Fusion bills each model it uses at standard rates, with a temporary 30% discount on paid plans
detail: Copilot Fusion combines multiple models per task. GitHub states that Fusion usage is billed for each model it uses, at each model's standard rate. For a limited time, users on paid Copilot plans receive a 30% discount on model costs when using Copilot Fusion. No end date for the discount is given.
impact: On a paid plan, work routed through Fusion currently costs 30% less in model charges than the same models used directly. The discount has no published end date, and one Fusion task can bill for several models.
